events.description: Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani has just won seven hundred dollars.
Chandler Bing asks whether Chandler Bing and Joey Tribbiani currently have any fruit.
Joey Tribbiani says Chandler Bing knows what Joey Tribbiani is about to say.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani currently feels that Joey Tribbiani has learned something over the past two weeks.
Chandler Bing asks whether Joey Tribbiani is going to stick with the 'it's all for her' approach.
Joey Tribbiani says Chandler Bing is crazy.
Joey Tribbiani says a blind man gets his sight back.
Joey Tribbiani asks whether the blind man walks around acting as if he is still blind after getting his sight back.
